title: Held-out English comprehension eval R6, NEW question kinds 2 (48 examples, 6 families)
note: HELD-OUT EVAL ONLY. Never use for training. Six NEW families not in the training bank or R5 (speech/quote, weather/condition, price/cost, direction/turn, duration/length, source/origin). Same answer-key policy as FRESH-EN-R3.json (free_answer_policy: mechanical normalization, then exact match against accepted_answers; yes_no accepts only Yes/No). Names are new relative to the bank, R3 and R5. Expose only source_text or paraphrase plus question strings to the learner.
